## Changes

**1. Route "other SIMD" instructions to WAVE rows (requirements 1 & 2)**

The `add()` helper previously assigned `row = "OTHER_SIMD"` for any packet whose name started with `OTHER_`. No `ProfileRangeEvent` device is now anything but `WAVE:*`, `ALUEXEC:*`, or `VMEMEXEC:*` — every one contains `EXEC` or `WAVE`.
